msg: Critical independent finding: installed 7.2.5 module tasdevice_config_put disassembly only clamps, locks, updates tas_priv->cur_conf, unlocks; no DSP call. Mainline identical. Thus Config Id 1 then 0 with no intervening OPEN does NOT force reload, especially post-OPEN. Force Firmware Load is persistent flag tested on OPEN by select_tuningprm_cfg, invalidating per-device cur_conf and forcing program/config/calibration reload. Datasheet p10 idle currents estimate two amps only ~0.07-0.13 W at 8-12V (mode dependent), far short of observed 0.65W. Runtime PM get_sync held whole PCM OPEN prevents amp runtime suspend while PCM alive.

R2 critique: low_power_idle_cpu_residency_us is LPIT FFH MSR-based and normally PKG C10 (drivers/acpi/acpi_lpit.c). Do not confuse it with system SLP_S0 counter. A zero observed only under held-open PCM cannot establish C10 behavior for the closed baseline. The S0-S1 subtraction proposal also assumes runtime-active means physically powered, which requires rail/firmware confirmation; no strict read-only amp-only separation. Dynamic debug skip absence does not prove calibration writes: function has silent early returns and errors are not propagated to OPEN.
